_readme: Curated map of feed catalog source names (src/config/feeds.ts FULL_FEEDS +
INTEL_SOURCES) to the ISO2 country codes each source is LOCAL to.
A source is local to country X when its primary editorial remit is X itself:
domestic outlets, country-dedicated services, and exile/diaspora outlets
focused on X (the Meduza/Moscow Times precedent from #5950).
Deliberately NOT tagged (the 'wires'):
- global-remit outlets and world desks (BBC World, Guardian World, Reuters,
AP News, CNN World)
- regional desks (BBC Africa, BBC Middle East, Al Jazeera, Jeune Afrique,
Africanews, The Diplomat, Eurasianet, InSight Crime)
- multi-source topic query feeds (Asia News, Africa News, Latin America,
Mexico Security, Sahel Crisis, India News Network)
- think tanks / analysis (Foreign Policy, ISW, RUSI, ...)
- government/institutional feeds where the country already has ample outlet
coverage (US gov category); included only where they ARE the local path
(Xinhua, MIIT/MOFCOM for CN; IRNA/Mehr/Fars for IR).
Only countries listed in shared/geography.js REGIONS[].keyCountries are
tagged. Consumed by scripts/geo-coverage-health.mjs (audit + report) and
tests/geo-coverage-health.test.mts. Keep names byte-identical to the
catalog `name` field — the test fails on drift.
